sloka: वानराणां च नादेन संरब्धो रावणस्तदा ।सम्भ्रमाविष्टहृदयो न किञ्चित् प्रत्यपद्यत ।। ६.५९.८४ ।।।।
transliteration: vānarāṇāṁ ca nādena saṁrabdho rāvaṇastadā ।sambhramāviṣṭahṛdayo na kiñcit pratyapadyata ।। 6.59.84 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter, seeing Neela's feat in the war, Ravana was agitated and the Vanaras were cheerful for having achieved their wish and shouted in joy.
